name: Turks & Caicos Islands
summary: Salt islands contested by Bermudian settlers and French expeditions.
notes: The track follows the principal salt islands and colonial administration, not simultaneous possession of every cay. Early French incursions were geographically partial and are annotated as such.

events.title: Ponce de León visits
events.detail: The voyage reached the islands in the period of Spanish slaving and depopulation.
events.qualification: A European claim; it does not establish island-wide administration or extinguish Indigenous rights.

events.title: Lucayan settlement disappears
events.detail: Enslavement and displacement devastated the Indigenous population.
events.uncertainty: An approximate marker for a gradual process, not a dated island-wide handover.

events.title: Bermudian salt-rakers arrive
events.detail: Seasonal English settlement grew around the salt ponds.
events.uncertainty: Use was seasonal and uneven; permanent communities developed later.

events.title: Privateers disrupt the salt islands
events.detail: French and Spanish privateers occupied Grand Turk and expelled salt-rakers.

events.title: Britain retakes possession
events.detail: A British expedition from Bermuda restored the settlers’ access.

events.title: French incursions
events.detail: French forces seized particular islands; these raids did not establish uniform control of the archipelago.

events.title: France evicts Bermudian salt-rakers
events.detail: French forces occupied the principal salt settlements.
events.uncertainty: This track represents the salt-island administration; other islands were not necessarily occupied.

events.title: France captures Grand Turk
events.detail: A French force held Grand Turk despite a British counterattack.

events.title: Administered through the Bahamas
events.detail: Both island groups were placed under Bahamian administration.

events.title: A separate crown colony
events.detail: The islands were separated from the Bahamas.

events.title: A dependency of Jamaica
events.detail: Administration moved within the British Empire.

events.title: Remaining under Britain
events.detail: The islands remained British as Jamaica became independent.
